title: Lantern Lake Fishing [left in English, not translated, while place names elsewhere are translated]
fish.golden_carp: Carp [ikan mas is the everyday name for the common carp; literally 'gold fish', and some players may picture an ornamental goldfish]
rarity.mythic: Myth [a noun, 'myth', not the adjective 'mythic'; reads a little odd as a rarity tag]
pass.lucky_bait: Lucky Bait doubles your chance of catching rare fish!
ascend.button: Rise [bangkit means rise up / get up / revive; on its own it does not suggest a prestige reset]
ascend.confirm: Rise now? You will start over from the beginning, but rare fish will be caught {bonus}% more often.
weather.storm: A storm is coming! Rare fish are biting right now. [badai datang can mean either 'a storm is coming' or 'the storm has arrived']
quest.title: Missions
codes.redeemed: Code redeemed successfully! Enjoy your reward.
afk.kicked: You were AFK too long, so fishing stopped. [unclear who stops: can read as 'so you stopped fishing' or even 'so stop fishing'; says nothing about being removed from the game]
event.ends: Ends in {time} [selesai means 'done/finished', so it can also read as 'finished within {time}']
daily.streak: {day} days in a row! Come back tomorrow for the next reward.
tip.night: Tip: some fish only bite at night.
group.join: Join our community and get 50 free bait! [vague: 'community' does not say it is a Roblox group]
